answer: An agent economy resists sybils with an escrow bond tied to a referral graph. Each identity locks 60 POA for 20 epochs, naming a sponsor, so links are visible: 100 fakes form a spiral of referrals in the ocean of accounts. Any peer may dispute a suspect; if three auditors agree it is fake, the bond is slashed and half goes to them. 100 fakes cost 6,000 POA vs a pool near 900, while one honest agent pays only 60. The graph republishes each dawn.
